assessments.reasoning: Condition 3 of the pinned LICENSE identifies the protected notice, both prohibited acts and the source-distribution trigger.

challenge.method: Tested replacing the notice with a short credit in a source distribution, editing the notice while retaining the authors’ names, and applying this clause to a binary-only shipment.
challenge.results: A short credit would remove the original notice. Editing the notice would alter it. Condition 3 bars both in a covered source distribution. A binary-only shipment supplies no source-distribution predicate on the stated facts, so this clause alone cannot establish a binary notice duty or overall compliance.

limitations: The clause presupposes a source distribution. Classifying a particular package and assessing additional notices would require evidence about its contents and terms.
reasoning: Condition 3 applies to any source distribution and prohibits both removal and alteration of the notice. Its scope includes unchanged covered source as well as altered covered source.
